script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Venus, your ruling planet of this Earth-ruled sign, is squaring off with Pluto in your second house of money and self-worth, forcing a deep re-evaluation of how you value what you own. That is why your usual steady confidence is being cracked open, and you might feel a sudden urge to break old patterns. For love, this is a powerful opposition between your heart's desire and commitment, so if you are taken, watch for possessiveness disguised as devotion; if single, attract someone who mirrors your need for emotional security. For career and money, the tenth house of public reputation is involved, so a bold move at work could either stall or launch your biggest monthly goal. Protect your boundaries with fiery patience, but an unexpected gift from a trusted source will ease your anxiety. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
